$comment: The night-lights square over Western Europe an hour and a half after its sunset: London, Paris, Benelux and the Ruhr lit, the sunset glow on the Earth's edge over the Atlantic beyond. The observer is on the great circle from Paris away from the Sun, in the Earth's shadow, so the meter exposes for the night. A candidate for the night-lighting card, not published: the moonlit ground (the Moon is nearly full) or the distance leaves its lights less striking than south-east Brazil's.
name: night-lights-orbit-europe
description: From 400 km over Slovakia at 18:00 UTC on 25 October 2026 (19:00 CET), looking south-west over the moonlit Alps to the lit Po Valley and the Adriatic, and the sunset glow on the Earth's edge beyond.
